newsitem.title: CANADA: Dundee Bancorp in C$60 mln stock sale deal.
newsitem.headline: Dundee Bancorp in C$60 mln stock sale deal.

text.p: Investment management firm Dundee Bancorp Inc said on Thursday that an underwriting syndicate acquired another 500,000 class A subordinate voting shares and agreed to acquire 500,000 more shares, all for C$20 a share.
In total, the syndicate agreed to acquire three million class A shares for a total of C$60 million, Dundee Bancorp said.
The shares closed on Wednesday at 20.50 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

The securities will be offered in Canada only and the issue is subject to regulatory approvals. The syndicate includes First Marathon Securities Ltd, ScotiaMcLeod Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc and Eagle & Partners Inc.
